key.name: delay
key.description: Index of the delay combo box: 0 = none, 1 = 3 seconds, 2 = 5 seconds, 3 = 10 seconds.

key.name: capture-mode
key.description: What to capture: 0 = ask the capture backend, 1 = area, 2 = window, 3 = whole screen.

key.name: jpeg-quality
key.description: Quality of JPEG output, from 1 (smallest file) to 100 (best detail). Ignored for PNG.

key.name: watermark
key.description: When true, overlay a date/time stamp on the screenshot before saving.

key.name: save-directory
key.description: Absolute path for saving screenshots. Empty string means the default ~/Pictures/Screenshots/.

key.name: preview
key.description: When true, show a preview window with crop support before saving.

key.name: watermark-format
key.description: Date format: 0 = YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, 1 = DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM, 2 = Mon DD, YYYY HH:MM, 3 = YYYY-MM-DD, 4 = HH:MM:SS.

key.name: watermark-text
key.description: Optional text prepended to the date stamp (e.g. brand name). Shown as "Text | date" when non-empty.

key.name: watermark-color
key.description: Text color: 0 = white (with dark shadow), 1 = black (with light shadow).
